1: // Simple Canvas Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas element with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width;
12:   const height = canvas.height;
13: 
14:   // Player configuration
15:   const player = {
16:     x: width / 2,
17:     y: height / 2,
18:     size: 20,
19:     speed: 4,
20:     color: '#00ff00',
21:   };
22: 
23:   // Input handling
24:   const keys = {};
25:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => (keys[e.key] = true));
26:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => (keys[e.key] = false));
27: 
28:   // Obstacles
29:   const obstacles = [];
30:   const obstacleSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
31:   const obstacleSpeed = 2;
32:   const obstacleSizeRange = [10, 30];
33:   let lastSpawn = 0;
34: 
35:   // Game state
36:   let score = 0;
37:   let startTime = null;
38:   let gameOver = false;
39: 
40:   function spawnObstacle() {
41:     const size = Math.random() * (obstacleSizeRange[1] - obstacleSizeRange[0]) + obstacleSizeRange[0];
42:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
43:     const speedX = Math.cos(angle) * obstacleSpeed;
44:     const speedY = Math.sin(angle) * obstacleSpeed;
45:     const x = Math.random() * width;
46:     const y = Math.random() * height;
47:     obstacles.push({ x, y, size, speedX, speedY, color: '#ff5555' });
48:   }
49: 
50:   function update(dt) {
51:     // Move player
52:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= player.speed;
53:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += player.speed;
54:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= player.speed;
55:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += player.speed;
56:     // Keep player within bounds
57:     player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, player.x));
58:     player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, player.y));
59: 
60:     // Spawn obstacles over time
61:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > obstacleSpawnInterval) {
62:       spawnObstacle();
63:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
64:     }
65: 
66:     // Update obstacles
67:     for (const o of obstacles) {
68:       o.x += o.speedX;
69:       o.y += o.speedY;
70:       // Wrap around edges
71:       if (o.x < -o.size) o.x = width + o.size;
72:       if (o.x > width + o.size) o.x = -o.size;
73:       if (o.y < -o.size) o.y = height + o.size;
74:       if (o.y > height + o.size) o.y = -o.size;
75:     }
76: 
77:     // Collision detection
78:     for (const o of obstacles) {
79:       const dx = o.x - player.x;
80:       const dy = o.y - player.y;
81:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
82:       if (dist < o.size + player.size / 2) {
83:         gameOver = true;
84:         break;
85:       }
86:     }
87: 
88:     // Update score
89:     if (!gameOver) {
90:       const now = performance.now();
91:       score = Math.floor((now - startTime) / 1000);
92:     }
93:   }
94: 
95:   function draw() {
96:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
97:     // Draw player
98:     ctx.fillStyle = player.color;
99:     ctx.beginPath();
100:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, player.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
101:     ctx.fill();
102: 
103:     // Draw obstacles
104:     for (const o of obstacles) {
105:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
106:       ctx.beginPath();
107:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
108:       ctx.fill();
109:     }
110: 
111:     // Draw score
112:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
113:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
114:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
115: 
116:     // Game over overlay
117:     if (gameOver) {
118:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
119:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
120:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
121:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
122:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
123:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127:   function loop(timestamp) {
128:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
129:     const dt = timestamp - (lastRender ?? timestamp);
130:     lastRender = timestamp;
131:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
132:     draw();
133:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
134:   }
135:   let lastRender;
136:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
137: })();
